title: Ground booking domain model
idea: The domain model separates the fixed venue (Ground, Court, Sport) from time-bound facts (TimeSlot, Booking), with PricingStrategy as a swappable rule.

analogy.text: A sports club's wall planner. The court names down the side never change; each week you pencil names into hour boxes.
analogy.breaks: A pencilled box never expires; an unpaid booking does.

points: A Ground has one or more Courts; each Court plays one Sport.
A TimeSlot is half-open whole hours; page 1's rules keep it to one day.
A Booking ties one player to one Court for one TimeSlot.
PricingStrategy turns a Court and TimeSlot into a price in minor units.

edges.label: has 1..*
edges.caption: A Ground owns its Courts. A Court never moves to another Ground.

edges.label: plays 1
edges.caption: Each Court plays one Sport, so a search by sport is a filter on Courts.

edges.label: for 1
edges.caption: A Booking points at exactly one Court. A Court has many Bookings over time.

edges.label: covers 1
edges.caption: A Booking covers one TimeSlot of one to three whole hours.

edges.label: by 1
edges.caption: A Booking belongs to one Player. The model keeps only the player id.

edges.label: has
edges.caption: BookingStatus is an enum. Page 4 turns it into a state machine.

edges.label: uses
edges.caption: PricingStrategy reads the Court and the TimeSlot. Peak and off-peak rules plug in here.

edges.label: uses
edges.caption: It also reads the Court, so outdoor or indoor courts can be priced differently.

code.title: The model in Java 17
code.caption: Records for fixed data, a class for Booking because its status changes. Each constructor checks the invariants it owns; slot length rules live in page 1's checks.

walk.text: One Ground with an outdoor football turf and an indoor badminton hall.
Three slots on one Friday. Ask which pairs overlap.
A lambda is a PricingStrategy. The Booking freezes the price it returns.
Three bad inputs: an unknown court, a half-hour start, a zero-hour slot.
The compact constructor refuses off-hour times and empty ranges.
Half-open ranges: 18:00-20:00 and 20:00-21:00 touch but do not overlap.
Booking changes only its status. Money is a long in minor units.

pitfalls: Do not store booked hours on Court; that mixes fixed layout with daily state.
Use half-open ranges, or back-to-back bookings will look like overlaps.
Keep money as long minor units; never use double for prices.

quiz.q: What does the second line of SportsModel print?
options: rejected: slots start on the hour
quiz.why: The first slot ends at 20:00 and the second starts at 20:00. With half-open ranges, start before other end fails, so they do not overlap.

takeaway: Venue classes stay fixed; bookings are time ranges placed on courts.
